say:3:1510310002:1.text: Doyle, I've fulfilled my promise to Perseus and brought back the captured soldiers.
say:3:1510310002:1.source_cn: 多尔，我履行了与珀尔修斯的约定，成功带回了被俘虏的士兵们。

say:4:1510310003:1.text: I'm not blind! Of course, I'm glad our brethren are back. That's not the problem.
say:4:1510310003:1.source_cn: 我不瞎，当然认得弟兄们回来了，但是……

say:5:1510310004:1.text: The problem is who these two are. A stranger wearing even stranger clothing and a little Wildborn brat.
say:5:1510310004:1.source_cn: 这些人又这么说？一个衣着怪异的陌生人，还有一个野蛮的小兽人！
say:5:1510310004:1.male: The problem is who these two are. A stranger wearing even stranger clothing and a little Wildborn brat.
say:5:1510310004:1.female: The problem is who these two are. A stranger wearing even stranger clothing and a little Wildborn brat.

say:8:1510310005:1.text: I am the emissary for the Hunting God.
say:8:1510310005:1.male: I am the emissary for the Hunting God.
say:8:1510310005:1.female: I am the emissary for the Hunting Goddess.

say:9:1510310006:1.text: God? What nonsense?! I don't see any god around here.
say:9:1510310006:1.source_cn: 呵……呵呵，神？你在说什么胡话，神在哪里？
say:9:1510310006:1.male: God? What nonsense?! I don't see any god around here.
say:9:1510310006:1.female: Goddess? What nonsense?! I don't see any goddess around here.

choice_prompt:10:1510310006.text: God? What nonsense?! I don't see any god around here.
choice_prompt:10:1510310006.source_cn: 呵……呵呵，神？你在说什么胡话，神在哪里？
choice_prompt:10:1510310006.male: God? What nonsense?! I don't see any god around here.
choice_prompt:10:1510310006.female: Goddess? What nonsense?! I don't see any goddess around here.

say:11:1510310007:0.text: The Hunting God stands before you. Bow your head and pay your respects.
say:11:1510310007:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人在此，呼临人，用你谦卑的双眼投来注目礼。
say:11:1510310007:0.male: The Hunting God stands before you. Bow your head and pay your respects.
say:11:1510310007:0.female: The Hunting Goddess stands before you. Bow your head and pay your respects.

say:12:1510310009:1.text: Are you saying this man is your so-called Hunting God?
say:12:1510310009:1.male: Are you saying this man is your so-called Hunting God?
say:12:1510310009:1.female: Are you saying this woman is your so-called Hunting Goddess?

say:13:1510310010:1.text: He's just a normal human! Like us!
say:13:1510310010:1.male: He's just a normal human! Like us!
say:13:1510310010:1.female: She's just a normal human! Like us!

say:15:1510310012:0.text: Oh, look at this little hairball! She looks like she's about to bite someone!
say:15:1510310012:0.source_cn: 哟，这小东西，生气起来像是能咬人呢！

say:16:1510310013:0.text: You should be chained up and locked in a cage.
say:16:1510310013:0.source_cn: 应该在你脖子上套上锁链，兽栏才是你该去的地方！

choice_prompt:17:1510310013.text: You should be chained up and locked in a cage.
choice_prompt:17:1510310013.source_cn: 应该在你脖子上套上锁链，兽栏才是你该去的地方！

narration:20:1510310014:0.text: You teach that soldier a painful lesson.
narration:20:1510310014:0.source_cn: 你让那个士兵吃了一点苦头

narration:21:1510310015:0.text: The blood drains from the soldier's face as you cast your magic.
narration:21:1510310015:0.source_cn: 对方见你施展魔法，脸上瞬间失了血色
narration:21:1510310015:0.male: The blood drains from the soldier's face as you cast your magic.
narration:21:1510310015:0.female: The blood drains from the soldier's face as you cast your magic.

say:22:1510310016:0.text: By God! This is real divine power!
say:22:1510310016:0.source_cn: 神……是神……！天啊！兽人的神竟然亲自来了……！
say:22:1510310016:0.male: By God! This is real divine power!
say:22:1510310016:0.female: By God! This is real divine power!

choice_prompt:23:1510310016.text: By God! This is real divine power!
choice_prompt:23:1510310016.source_cn: 神……是神……！天啊！兽人的神竟然亲自来了……！
choice_prompt:23:1510310016.male: By God! This is real divine power!
choice_prompt:23:1510310016.female: By God! This is real divine power!

say:24:1510310017:0.source_cn: 噫……！珀尔修斯统帅、珀尔修斯统帅——！

narration:25:1510310018:0.text: At your rebuke, the soldier flees.
narration:25:1510310018:0.source_cn: 在你的威严下，士兵一溜烟逃走了

say:29:1510310019:0.text: The Herdmaster is our true god. His powers speak for themselves.
say:29:1510310019:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人就是狩猎神大人。
say:29:1510310019:0.male: The Herdmaster is our true god. His powers speak for themselves.
say:29:1510310019:0.female: The Herdmaster is our true goddess. Her powers speak for themselves.

say:30:1510310020:0.text: Herdmaster, please forgive them all. Your power is too much for mortals to bear.
say:30:1510310020:0.source_cn: 狩猎神，请宽恕他们吧，凡人承受不起你的神力。
say:30:1510310020:0.male: Herdmaster, please forgive them all. Your power is too much for mortals to bear.
say:30:1510310020:0.female: Herdmaster, please forgive them all. Your power is too much for mortals to bear.

say:31:1510310021:0.text: As guests, we should observe proper courtesies. Entering uninvited would only provoke them.
say:31:1510310021:0.source_cn: 身为客人，在没受到邀请之前，贸然登门拜访会加深他们的恐惧。

say:32:1510310022:0.text: It seems that we'd better wait here until the soldiers come back.
say:32:1510310022:0.source_cn: 看来，在士兵回来之前，我们先在此等待为好。

say:33:1510310023:0.text: What do you think, little emissary?

say:34:1510310024:0.text: Herdmaster, I have something to say...
say:34:1510310024:0.male: Herdmaster, I have something to say...
say:34:1510310024:0.female: Herdmaster, I have something to say...

choice:23:1:2.source_cn: 叫你们的统帅赶快见人

choice:23:2:3.text: Calm down, I come in peace.
choice:23:2:3.source_cn: 不必担心，我为和平而来
choice:23:2:3.male: Calm down, I come in peace.
choice:23:2:3.female: Calm down, I come in peace.

choice:17:1:2.male: (Cast a Paralyze spell on the soldier)
choice:17:1:2.female: (Cast a Paralyze spell on the soldier)

choice:17:2:3.male: (Use magic to make the soldier fall)
choice:17:2:3.female: (Use magic to make the soldier fall)

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 凡人，睁开你的眼睛看清楚

say:38:1510310008:1.text: How dare you disrespect the Wildborn god, Halian? Your foolishness will be your doom.
say:38:1510310008:1.source_cn: 呼临人，你胆敢对雅库伯尔的神明不敬，必将遭受恶果。
say:38:1510310008:1.male: How dare you disrespect the Wildborn god, Halian? Your foolishness will be your doom.
say:38:1510310008:1.female: How dare you disrespect the Wildborn goddess, Halian? Your foolishness will be your doom.
